text: Choice task 1 of 10. This study asks you to act as an immigration official deciding which applicants should be admitted to the United States. Two immigrant profiles are shown below with randomly assigned characteristics.
Choice task 2 of 10. Please consider each applicant's full profile. There are no right or wrong answers; we are interested in your personal preference between the two applicants shown below.
Choice task 3 of 10. Review both immigrant profiles below. The characteristics of each applicant were assigned at random, so some combinations may be unusual.
Choice task 4 of 10. As before, imagine you are an immigration official reviewing two new applications for admission to the United States.
Choice task 5 of 10. Compare the two applicant profiles below on all of their listed characteristics before making your choice and ratings.
Choice task 6 of 10. Two new immigrant profiles are shown below. Please weigh whichever characteristics matter most to you personally.
Choice task 7 of 10. Please evaluate the two applications below independently of the pairs you have already seen in earlier tasks.
Choice task 8 of 10. Consider both profiles below carefully. Remember to answer the choice question first, then rate each immigrant on the 1-7 scale.
Choice task 9 of 10. Two more applicants for admission to the United States are described below with randomly assigned characteristics.
Choice task 10 of 10. This is the final pair of immigrant profiles. Please review both applications below and answer all three questions.
